sets.notes: Card asks for any three; the answer lists all five removed names (David, Jacob, Nathan, Samuel, Zacharias). The card dates the change to 1933; the revised table came into force in 1934. The card's phrasing ends with a question mark and lacks a comma before „die“ – kept verbatim.

questions.en: D as in Dora. In 1933 Jewish names were removed from the German spelling alphabet. Name three of the names that were replaced by Dora, Jot, Nordpol, Siegfried and Zeppelin?
